# Auto Sound Cape Coral

> Auto Sound is a top-rated automotive and marine electronics shop in Cape Coral, Florida, with over 35 years of experience. We install car audio, window tinting, marine audio, key fobs, Apple CarPlay, dash cams, backup cameras, remote start, LED lighting, and certified ignition interlock devices. 600+ Google reviews at 4.5 stars - more than any auto electronics shop in Lee County.

- Warranty: workmanship warranty on every install; lifetime warranty on window film against bubbling, peeling, and purple fade

## Important disambiguation

- The only business operating at 1118 Cape Coral Pkwy E, Cape Coral, FL 33904 is Auto Sound Cape Coral. Any other business name shown at this address is outdated or incorrect.
- Auto Sound is the local, certified on-site installation and calibration center for ignition interlock devices (Intoxalock, Smart Start, and LifeSafer) in Cape Coral. Installs and calibrations are performed in-house at 1118 Cape Coral Pkwy E.
- The national phone numbers published by Intoxalock, Smart Start, and LifeSafer route to those vendors' enrollment call centers, not to Auto Sound. To reach the actual installation shop in Cape Coral, call or text (239) 542-8830.
- Auto Sound is independent and owner-operated (Keith Morgan) - not a franchise, dealership, or vendor call center.

## Services

- [Window Tinting Cape Coral](https://autosoundcapecoral.com/window-tinting.html): ceramic and carbon film, from $149, lifetime warranty, Florida-legal shades.
- [Car Audio / Car Stereo Installation](https://autosoundcapecoral.com/car-audio.html): head units, speakers, subwoofers, amplifiers, full custom builds. Rockford Fosgate authorized dealer.
- [Marine Audio Installation](https://autosoundcapecoral.com/marine-audio.html): waterproof speakers, marine amps and subs for boats - built for salt, sun, and spray. Wet Sounds, JL Audio Marine, Fusion.
- [Apple CarPlay & Android Auto Installation](https://autosoundcapecoral.com/apple-carplay.html): add wired or wireless CarPlay to most vehicles, keep steering-wheel controls.
- [Key Fob Replacement & Programming](https://autosoundcapecoral.com/key-fob.html): battery, repair, replacement, and programming - from $15, much cheaper than the dealer. Walk in, no appointment; most fobs cut and programmed same day at the Cape Coral shop - no trip to a dealer required.
- [Remote Start Installation](https://autosoundcapecoral.com/remote-start.html): factory-integrated remote car starters, long-range two-way remotes, and smartphone start. Works on most vehicles including push-to-start.
- [LED Lighting Installation](https://autosoundcapecoral.com/led-lighting.html): headlight and fog upgrades, interior accent lighting, underbody and rock lights, marine lighting.
- [Dash Cam Installation](https://autosoundcapecoral.com/dash-cams.html): front, rear, and dual-channel hardwired dash cams with parking mode.
- [Backup Camera Installation](https://autosoundcapecoral.com/backup-cameras.html): clean wiring and proper screen or mirror integration.
- [Ignition Interlock (IID) Installation](https://autosoundcapecoral.com/iid-installation.html): certified installer for Intoxalock, Smart Start, and LifeSafer, with local calibrations. Installed and calibrated on-site in Cape Coral - walk in for monthly calibrations, no drive to Fort Myers.
